options swap_delay=12 iteration=3000 ignore_burst_energy=true;

kokomi char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
kokomi add weapon="prototypeamber" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
kokomi add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
kokomi add stats er=0.3;

sara char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
sara add weapon="slingshot" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
sara add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
sara add stats er=0.3;

jean char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
jean add weapon="harbingerofdawn" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
jean add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
jean add stats er=0.3;

bennett char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
bennett add weapon="harbingerofdawn" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
bennett add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
bennett add stats er=0.3;

target lvl=100 resist=0.1 radius=2 pos=0,2.4 hp=999999999;

active kokomi;
for let i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1 {
  kokomi skill;
  sara skill, aim[hold=1];
  jean skill, burst;
  wait(1200);
}
